mapper.sql: r.id, r.product_id, r.sku_id, r.order_item_id, r.rating, r.content, r.anonymous, r.follow_content, r.follow_time, r.create_time, oi.product_name, oi.image as product_image, oi.spec_text, coalesce(u.nickname, u.username) as nickname
from mall_review r left join mall_order_item oi on oi.id = r.order_item_id left join sys_user u on u.id = r.user_id
mapper.insert: insert into mall_review (order_id, order_number, order_item_id, user_id, product_id, sku_id, rating, content, anonymous, create_time, update_time) values (#{orderId}, #{orderNumber}, #{orderItemId}, #{userId}, #{productId}, #{skuId}, #{rating}, #{content}, #{anonymous}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: select * from mall_review where order_id = #{orderId} order by id asc
mapper.update: update mall_review set follow_content = #{content}, follow_time = #{followTime}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and follow_time is null
mapper.select: select count(*) from mall_review where product_id = #{productId}
select round(avg(rating), 2) from mall_review where product_id = #{productId}
select count(*) from mall_review where product_id = #{productId} and rating >= 4
select rating as star, count(*) as count from mall_review where product_id = #{productId} group by rating order by rating desc
